capabilities: preserve scroll position when switching between Edit and Reading modes
trigger an invisible DOM scroll refresh to sync viewport caches
extras: Can also be installed via BRAT; the README only describes the problem and mechanism without usage examples or screenshots.
intentEvidence: preserves your exact scroll position when toggling between Editing View and Reading View (Ctrl + E)
problem: In long documents with tables, callouts, and code blocks, switching between edit and reading modes jumps the scroll position to the top.
summary: Scroll position fixer that preserves the exact scroll location when toggling between Editing View and Reading View.
